title: Siouan Language Group of Native Americans – Legends of America
text: The Catawba, Mandan, Iowa-Oto, Kansa, Osage, Biloxi, Ofo, and Tutelo languages are already extinct. Today, Siouan languages are primarily spoken in the American Great Plains and the southern part of Canada. Only the Dakota, Lakota, Stoney, and Crow tribes retain many speakers.
